_comment_name: Display name shown in chrome://extensions and CWS listing
name: Starter Extension
_comment_description: One-line description (≤132 chars). Shown in CWS and extensions page.
description: Replace this with what your extension does.
_comment_icons: Provide 16x16, 48x48, 128x128 PNGs. Used in toolbar, management page, CWS.
_comment_action: Defines the toolbar button. popup: the HTML to show on click.
_comment_background: MV3 service worker — replaces MV2 persistent background page.
_comment_content_scripts: Injected into pages matching 'matches'. Remove if no content script needed.

content_scripts._comment_matches: URL patterns where content.js will be injected.

_comment_permissions: Only request what you actually use. Each permission is visible to users.
_comment_host_permissions: Domains your extension can make requests to or read. Use sparingly.
_comment_web_accessible_resources: Files the extension makes accessible to web pages (e.g. injected images or CSS).
